subject.title: Dashboard: chart widgets (line, bar, area, sparkline, gauge)

question: Should OpenClaw accept chart widgets as first-party dashboard builtins through the active dashboard stack, or keep charting in custom/ClawHub widgets until the dashboard product surface settles?
rationale: The request is useful, but it adds bundled dashboard product surface on top of unmerged infrastructure; VISION.md and AGENTS.md keep optional/core surface on a high bar and require maintainer direction for plugin and UI product scope.

options.title: Keep Open And Review The Linked PR
options.body: Treat this issue as the canonical chart-widget leaf item and decide it through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101792 after the dashboard foundation is acceptable.

options.title: Defer Builtins Until Dashboard Settles
options.body: Keep the roadmap item open but pause implementation until the modular-dashboard substrate lands cleanly on main.

options.title: Route Charting To Custom Widgets First
options.body: Ask contributors to prove charting through custom widgets or ClawHub-style packages before adding more first-party builtins.

recommendation.title: Keep Open And Review The Linked PR
recommendation.body: Treat this issue as the canonical chart-widget leaf item and decide it through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101792 after the dashboard foundation is acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-main history signal for the Control UI plugin-tab seam that this dashboard product decision extends.
